# Check what happens with various bump_build scenarios
script = """from src.semver.version import Version

# Test with no build metadata
v1 = Version.parse("1.2.3")
print(f"No build: {repr(v1.bump_build())}")

# Test with empty string token
v2 = Version.parse("1.2.3+alpha")
bumped2 = v2.bump_build("")
print(f'Empty token: {repr(bumped2)}')

# Test with None token
v3 = Version.parse("1.2.3+alpha")
bumped3 = v3.bump_build(None)
print(f'None token: {repr(bumped3)}')

# Test with default token
v4 = Version.parse("1.2.3+alpha")
bumped4 = v4.bump_build()
print(f'Default token: {repr(bumped4)}')
"""
r = await world.call('repo.write_file', path='test_current.py', content=script)
print(r)
